paragraphs: James completed the sale of his company in April. James and Caroline seek long-term growth with a balanced-to-moderate approach to risk and do not currently require income from the portfolio. Their priority is to build a tax-efficient base that can replace James’s income when he steps back from full-time work; any recommendations should be assessed against this objective. They may also wish to help with their grandchildren’s school fees and make a charitable donation in future.
